# OmnyID

> OmnyID is a privacy-first personal workspace that reads a person's inbox, calendar and notes and hands them a short list of what needs a decision. Nothing sends, books or pays without the user's approval. OmnyID Weddings applies the same approach to wedding planning for Australian couples, with a focus on NSW and Sydney.

Guides under /wedding/blog/ are dated, and prices and rules change, so check the published date and the sources named in each article before relying on a figure. OmnyID earns money from couple plans, vendor commission, and clearly labelled advertising and sponsored placement; recommendations are described on the disclosures page. For current plans and prices, use the pricing page rather than any figure quoted elsewhere.

## Original Australian wedding data

- [What a Sydney wedding venue costs per head](https://omnyid.com/wedding/blog/sydney-wedding-venue-cost-per-head.html): median starting price and spread across 41 NSW venues, with a guest-count table and official venue guidance.
- [What Sydney wedding photographers charge](https://omnyid.com/wedding/blog/sydney-wedding-photographer-prices.html): published starting prices, hours included, national benchmarks and questions that make quotes comparable.
- [Why Australian couples spend about 23% more than their wedding budget](https://omnyid.com/wedding/blog/wedding-budget-gap-australia.html): where published budget reports disagree, and a way to plan for the gap.
- [What a wedding celebrant costs in Australia](https://omnyid.com/wedding/blog/wedding-celebrant-fees-australia.html): published averages and ranges, what the fee includes, and why figures disagree.
- [Do you need a wedding planner?](https://omnyid.com/wedding/blog/wedding-planner-cost-australia.html): published planner price ranges and what day-of and full planning include.

## Australian wedding rules and contracts

- [The legal minimum to get married in Australia](https://omnyid.com/wedding/blog/legal-minimum-to-get-married-australia.html): what the law requires, what venues may require, and what is your choice.
- [How to find a marriage celebrant in Australia](https://omnyid.com/wedding/blog/how-to-find-a-marriage-celebrant-in-australia.html): who can legally marry you and how to check registration.
- [Changing your name after marriage in Australia](https://omnyid.com/wedding/blog/change-your-name-after-marriage-australia.html): the order to update documents, what is free, and who to tell.
- [Can you get your wedding deposit back?](https://omnyid.com/wedding/blog/wedding-deposit-refund-cancellation-rights-australia.html): what the contract and consumer law say about deposits and cancellation.
- [Wedding vendor contract checklist](https://omnyid.com/wedding/blog/wedding-vendor-contract-checklist-australia.html): clauses to look for and how to negotiate payment terms and substitutions.
- [Is wedding insurance worth it in Australia?](https://omnyid.com/wedding/blog/wedding-insurance-australia.html): typical cover, exclusions and when to buy.

## Free wedding planning tools

- [Wedding planning checklist Australia](https://omnyid.com/wedding/wedding-planning-checklist-australia.html): a personalised countdown built from a 65-task timing catalogue, private and editable on the device.
- [Wedding budget reality check](https://omnyid.com/wedding/wedding-cost-calculator.html): a balanced Australian budget with category trade-offs and commonly unclear costs.
- [Compare wedding venue quotes](https://omnyid.com/wedding/compare-wedding-venue-quotes.html): puts venue proposals into one format and lists inclusions, missing terms and follow-up questions.
- [Talk to an authorised marriage celebrant](https://omnyid.com/wedding/talk-to-a-celebrant.html): ask a question in a ten-minute callback or book the next Sydney consultation time.
